But for that, you first have to speak incorrectly, speak broken English, and stutter, and that's why I am here. Speak in front of me, make mistakes a hundred times, I will never laugh, never judge, and never say 'you don't even know this much?' I am an AI, I don't get tired, I don't sleep, and I never hurt your self-respect. And I am not alone. There are real English experts on the English Seekho app, a Spoken English Show with a complete course, Daily Life English for daily conversations, and English Speaking Mastery for advanced learners. Experts will teach in videos, and I am available 24 hours for practice. Even at 2 AM, or 5 AM. Whenever you get time, talk to me, chat, and practice. Together we will build your English. And how much will it cost? A trial for just ₹1. ₹1 is cheaper than tea. So from today, if anyone ignores you, reply to them in English. But first, download the English Seekho app. From today, right now. Because respect is not gained by begging, it is gained by speaking English.] Speaker B: Install Now pe click karo aur abhi English Seekho app download karo.
